headline: Bentota: River Estuaries, Bawa Gardens & Golden West-Coast Sands
description:
Where the Bentota river meets the sea, a long golden beach runs south past fishing villages and turtle hatcheries. Inland lies Lunuganga, the country garden Geoffrey Bawa shaped for fifty years, and his brother Bevis’s whimsical Brief Garden.

Bentota is only ninety minutes from the airport, which makes it my favourite first or last stop — and the base for Ayurveda programmes with resident physicians.

guideNote.heading: Where I Send Guests to Exhale
paragraphs: After the hill country and the parks, Bentota is about doing very little beautifully: a morning in Bawa’s garden, a boat drifting through the mangroves, an Ayurvedic treatment and a long swim when the sea is calm.

experiences.title: Lunuganga: Bawa’s Living Garden
experiences.text: Terraces, follies and framed views across Dedduwa lake — the place where Sri Lanka’s greatest architect experimented with landscape for half a century.

image.alt: Courtyard and lily pond at Geoffrey Bawa's Lunuganga estate in Bentota

experiences.title: Estuary Sailing & River Safari
experiences.text: Sail the sheltered estuary or drift up the Bentota river through mangrove tunnels, past monitor lizards, kingfishers and riverside temples.

image.alt: Executive team sailing catamarans in turquoise coastal waters

experiences.title: Kosgoda Sea Turtle Hatchery
experiences.text: A small community hatchery that protects eggs from poachers and releases hatchlings at night — visited quietly, without handling the turtles.

fieldNotes.title: Monsoon Seas
fieldNotes.text: From May to October the sea is rough on this coast. Swim only where it is safe — the river and the pool are lovely alternatives.

fieldNotes.title: Ayurveda Consultation
fieldNotes.text: Genuine retreats begin with a physician’s consultation. Allow at least three days for treatments to make a real difference.

fieldNotes.title: Turtle Ethics
fieldNotes.text: I avoid hatcheries that keep turtles in tanks for photos. The one we visit releases hatchlings straight to the sea.

tours.title: Ceylon Family Wonder & Discovery
tours.summary: Eleven gentle days built around children and grandparents alike: wild elephants from the safari jeep, a village day by bullock cart and canoe, junior naturalist kits, a turtle hatchery and safe surf and kayak sessions on the west coast.

cover.alt: Family walking beside an elephant mother and calf in an Udawalawe sanctuary

tours.title: Ayurveda, Healing & Forest Silence
tours.summary: A restorative sanctuary journey designed to recalibrate mental and physical vitality. Daily consultations with resident Ayurvedic Vaidyas, endemic forest bathing, and private oceanfront meditation.

cover.alt: Open-air yoga shala above a lily pond in the Sinharaja rainforest
